milestones.title: Eight saved native fields analyzed; two representative cases independently checked
milestones.summary: The parent analysis checked 112 saved-file hashes across eight grids and found same-index spreader-to-sink drops of 51.10–52.40 K. A separate parser checked 28 hashes for baseline16/32 only, corroborating 51.10 K and 51.60 K. Baseline32 has chip peak 118.89 C, spreader rise 70.11 K and sink rise 18.51 K at chip argmax index 527 (16,15).
limitations: These are hand-authored 50 mm probes, not the historical Ascend-v3 study or agent optimization. Only the two representative cases were independently re-parsed.
Retained argv/raw dimensions are 16×16 and 32×32 with map=max, despite config defaults 64×64/centre. Native block-centre output is a different metric.
Both retained configurations use r_convec 0.009; this rules out unscaled 0.1 for those configurations only. It does not establish the repair or physical fidelity.
Raw output precision is 0.01 K. The same chip-layer argmax index is used across layers, not each layer maximum.
Binary binding comes from the retained report and was not independently rehashed. No fresh solve, reproduction run or physical calibration occurred.

evidenceTimes.note: Parent saved-field extraction 2026-10-31T14:41:26.241Z; independent two-case review 2026-10-31T14:45:18.5407475Z. Neither timestamp is a new experiment time.
